# Read data

```{r specify-path}
#resultsFolder = "../../../cpp/netlings2.0/"
path = paste0("../../../results/preliminary_20220926/")

# read results
#allNetsResults <- read.table(paste0(path, "/allNetsResults_prepped.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

# read paramsScalar
paramsScalar <- read.table(file = paste0(path, "paramsScalarSel"), 
                     sep = " ", header = FALSE, col.names = c("param", "val"))
num_nodes = paramsScalar$val[paramsScalar$param == "NUM_NODES"]
num_generations = paramsScalar$val[paramsScalar$param == "NUM_GENERATIONS"]
paramsVector <- as.matrix(read.table(paste0(path, "paramsVectorSel_OneGeneStab"), sep = " ", 
                                     header = FALSE, row.names = 1))

# names
node_names = paste("G", 1:num_nodes, sep = "")
genotypesColnames <- paste("G_", node_names, sep = "")
phenotypesColnames <- paste("P_", node_names, sep = "")
sBasalColnames <- paste("S_", node_names, sep = "")

# extract 
colnames(paramsVector) <- node_names
s_basal <- paramsVector["S_BASAL", ]
starting_noise_int <- paramsVector["STARTING_NOISE_INT", ]
selpress <- paramsVector["SELPRESS", ]
s_opt_delta <- paramsVector["S_OPT_DELTA", ]

steadyState <- read.table(paste0(path, "fossilsNeu.steadyStates"), sep = " ", header = FALSE)
colnames(steadyState) <- node_names
```

## Load packages & misc

```{r load-packages}
# Package list
packages <- c("dplyr",
              "nlme", 
              "MuMIn", # for r.squared in lme models
              "ggplot2",
              "ggpubr", # for the pubclean theme
              "ggridges", 
              "gridExtra",
              "cowplot", # for arranging plots
              "infotheo",
              "lme4", 
              "car", # for vif measure
              "RColorBrewer", # for color palettes
              "latex2exp", # for latex notation in the plots
              "reshape2", 
              "formattable", # for nice tables
              "htmltools", # for outputting the table
              "webshot") # for outputting the table

# Install packages not yet installed
installed_packages <- packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(installed_packages == FALSE)) {
  install.packages(packages[!installed_packages])
}

# Packages loading
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

# colors for plots
noiseColor = "#01665e"
genotypeNoiseColor = "#7b3294"
genotypeSBasalColor = "#08519c"
phenotypeColor = "#d95f0e"
fitnessColor = "#e78ac3"
neutralityColor = "darkgray"
customGreenAIC = "#41ab5d"
```

# Stabilizing selection

```{r add-optimal-expression-level-stab}
geneNum = 5
geneName = node_names[geneNum]
sEq = unlist(steadyState[geneNum])
sOpt = sEq + unlist(s_opt_delta[geneNum])
focalGeneGenotype = genotypesColnames[geneNum]
focalGenePhenotype = phenotypesColnames[geneNum]
focalGeneSBasal = sBasalColnames[geneNum]
```

## One gene

```{r read-data-one-gene-stab}
# read hist file
histFile <- read.table(file = paste0(path, "fossilsOneGeneStab.hist"), sep = " ", header = FALSE)
colnames(histFile) <- c("generation", "cell", "IDGenotype", "IDNet", "IDNoise", "IDSBasal", phenotypesColnames, "fitness")
histFile$scen <- "selection"

# read noises file
noisesIDFile <- read.table(file = paste0(path, "fossilsOneGeneStab.noises"), sep = " ", header = FALSE)
noisesIDFile <- noisesIDFile[, -dim(noisesIDFile)[2]]
colnames(noisesIDFile) <- c("IDNoise", genotypesColnames)

# read sbasals file
sBasalsIDFile <- read.table(file = paste0(path, "fossilsOneGeneStab.sbasals"), sep = " ", header = FALSE)
sBasalsIDFile <- sBasalsIDFile[, -dim(sBasalsIDFile)[2]]
colnames(sBasalsIDFile) <- c("IDSBasal", sBasalColnames)

# merge
noisesHist <- inner_join(histFile[, c("generation", "cell", "IDNoise")], noisesIDFile, by = "IDNoise")
sBasalsHist <- inner_join(histFile[, c("generation", "cell", "IDSBasal")], sBasalsIDFile, by = "IDSBasal")
```

```{r plot-one-gene-stab}
plot_noiseGenotypeDynamics_OneGeneStab <- ggplot(data = 
  data.frame(x = noisesHist[,"generation"], y = noisesHist[,eval(focalGeneGenotype)]), aes(x = x, y = y)) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.01, color = genotypeNoiseColor) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun.y = median, geom = "line", size = 1, color = genotypeNoiseColor) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold")) +
  labs(subtitle = paste0("Stabilizing selection, 1 gene selected"),
       x = "Generations", y = "Intrinsic noise parameter") + 
  ylim(0, 200)
plot_noiseGenotypeDynamics_OneGeneStab

plot_sBasalsGenotypeDynamics_OneGeneStab <- ggplot(data = 
  data.frame(x = sBasalsHist[,"generation"], y = sBasalsHist[,eval(focalGeneSBasal)]), aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.01, color = genotypeSBasalColor) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun.y = median, geom = "line", size = 1, color = genotypeSBasalColor) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = sOpt) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold")) +
  labs(subtitle = paste0(""), x = "Generations", y = "Basal expression level") + 
  ylim(0, 100)
plot_sBasalsGenotypeDynamics_OneGeneStab

plot_phenotypeDynamics_OneGeneStab <- ggplot(data = 
  data.frame(x = histFile[,"generation"], y = histFile[,eval(focalGenePhenotype)]), aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.01, color = phenotypeColor) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun.y = median, geom = "line", size = 1, color = phenotypeColor) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = sOpt) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold")) +
  labs(subtitle = paste0(""), x = "Generations", y = "Expression level") + 
  ylim(0, 100)
plot_phenotypeDynamics_OneGeneStab
```


```{r final-plot}
ggsave(filename = paste0("plot_joint_", geneName, "_uniformDistr.png"),
```
